scope.databaseSelection: atlas_packets rows with missing summaries, ordered by domain/path/packet key

implementation.change: Persistence now requires --apply (the existing package apply command already supplies it). No --apply, or an explicit --dry-run, exits after the read-only cohort and job plan. Planning does not probe model slots, connect to Valkey, send text to Gemma, write summaries, or queue GPU jobs.
implementation.liveConcurrency: The existing shared-queue worker pool remains bounded by the resolved llama-server slot count plus one, with a hard maximum of eight workers. Live summarization still requires the explicit --apply flag; no live summarization workers were started.

limitations: The observed worker count is a planned concurrency setting, not a throughput benchmark.

The 5,000-row feature matrix remains provenance-blocked and has sparse GA plus empty age/hit signals; CPU threading that trivial five-scalar-per-row calculation would not address those missing inputs.
The stale native addon was not rebuilt; build artifacts and disk headroom were not modified.
nextGate: Authorize a bounded summary persistence run only after packet identity/provenance and destination write policy are reviewed; measure throughput and failure/retry behavior before increasing concurrency.
